display_name: YouTube Partner Program - ad and Premium revenue share
what_it_pays_for: A share of the advertising sold against your videos, plus a share of Premium subscription revenue from Premium members who watch you. This is the tier most creators mean by 'getting monetized', and it is the higher of the two Partner Program bars.

revenue_basis.note: Channel views times the creator's own RPM. Checked 2026-09-15 on YouTube's own page (https://support.google.com/youtube/answer/9314357, 'Understand ad revenue analytics'): 'RPM is your total revenue (after YouTube's revenue share) per 1000 views', 'RPM is based on several revenue sources, including: ads, channel memberships, YouTube Premium revenue, Super Chat, and Super Stickers', and 'For Shorts, it includes all engaged views. For Videos, it includes all views.' No rate is published in advance and none is carried here: the RPM is the creator's figure, or an estimate labelled as one.

additional_requirements_not_assessed: No active Community Guidelines strikes on the channel
The channel is in a country or region where the programme operates
2-Step Verification enabled on the associated account
A linked and approved payments account
Monetization can also be removed after six months with no upload and no Posts-tab activity

From 2027-02-01 a channel stays in the programme by meeting any of: 1,000 qualified watch hours in 365 days, 1 million qualified Shorts views in 90 days, or 2 long-form videos or 5 Shorts uploaded every 90 days. Falling below gives a 90-day window to recover.

provenance.note: The eligibility overview announces the 2027-02-01 update, with updated terms to be accepted by 2027-01-31, but states none of its numbers. The numbers are on the changes page, and the two from_2027 paths in this program are verified against that page; the same raise was announced on the platform's blog on 2026-08-10. Country list transcribed 2026-08-27 from YouTube Partner Program availability: 129 entries -> 129 ISO codes. The grandfather clause is stated on the changes page: 「If you are already in YPP, your status is not impacted by this update.」

zh-CN.display_name: YouTube 合作伙伴计划——广告与会员分成
zh-CN.what_it_pays_for: 把广告卖在你的视频上，你拿其中一份；同时，付费会员看你的内容，你也能分到一部分会员费。大多数人说的「开通盈利」指的就是这一档，它是合作伙伴计划两道门里更高的那道。
additional_requirements_not_assessed: 频道没有生效中的社区准则警告。
该计划只在部分国家和地区开放，需要确认你的账号所在地在名单内。
关联账号需开启两步验证。
需已开通进阶功能权限。
需要绑定并通过审核的收款账户。
另外，连续六个月既不发视频也不发动态，已开通的收益可能被收回。
2027-02-01 起，要留在计划内需满足任一条：365 天 1,000 小时合格观看时长、90 天 100 万次合格 Shorts 播放，或每 90 天发 2 条长视频或 5 条 Shorts。掉下去有 90 天窗口补回来。

zh-CN.label: 你的频道 RPM
zh-CN.where_to_find: YouTube Studio > 数据分析 > 收入 > RPM（每千次观看收入，已经扣过 YouTube 的分成）

revenue_model.note: RPM is already after YouTube's revenue share and covers ads, channel memberships, YouTube Premium, Super Chat and Super Stickers, so this is the channel's total YouTube income after the share - not ad revenue alone - and no share comes off it again. It counts Shorts engaged views together with long-form views. It is before tax.

zh-CN.note: RPM 已经扣过 YouTube 的分成，而且不只是广告：还包括频道会员、YouTube Premium、Super Chat 和 Super Stickers 的收入。所以这是整个频道在 YouTube 上分成后的总收入估算，不是纯广告收入，也不要再扣一次分成。它把 Shorts 的有效观看和长视频观看算在一起。这是税前数字。
